dispositions.area: Vendor-neutral notification policy, recipient routing and event contracts
dispositions.evidence: The existing project-over-global contact normalization, direct GitHub authority, content requirements and fail-closed policy are sound.

The locked atomic JSON ledger and payload fingerprint are sound; add atomic dispatch ownership, deterministic provider operation identity, submitted state, bounded retry and terminal-delivery reconciliation.
The approved ACS Email resources, sender and managed-identity design remain appropriate; add the official JavaScript EmailClient transport without connection strings or keys.
Existing Log Analytics is suitable. ACS submission success only means out-for-delivery, so recipient-level ACSEmailStatusUpdateOperational evidence is required before SENT.
Retain the existing user-assigned runtime identity and Log Analytics workspace; codify ACS role assignment, least-privilege log read, diagnostic settings and non-secret runtime metadata.
Observability correlation fields exist but no durable GitHub footer format was configured; add one normalized project profile and validator rather than ad hoc labels.
No new vendor is introduced. Azure Monitor delivery reconciliation replaces the need for a new webhook provider or secret-bearing endpoint.

consultations: Delivery Orchestrator: bounded Issue #18 implementation sequence and no-product-work stop condition
Architecture Guardian: preserve vendor-neutral ledger/transport boundary and distinguish provider submission from delivery
Reliability & Operations: atomic lease, deterministic operation ID, bounded retries, terminal failure reconciliation and diagnostic-log latency
Security & Privacy: managed identity, recipient allow-list, plain-text/minimized content, engagement tracking disabled, no credential persistence and public-Issue redaction
Repository Steward: Bicep/CI/Docker integration, GitHub attribution validation and reproducible commands
QA & Release Lead: separate immutable-candidate independent verification and synthetic blocking/UAT conformance events
risks: Live Azure sender/domain, role assignments, diagnostic categories and Log Analytics ingestion cannot be confirmed until an authorised interactive Azure login succeeds.
Actual ACS terminal delivery cannot be claimed until recipient-level Azure Monitor evidence is observed for both conformance events.
Azure Monitor delivery logs are asynchronous; the check path must report SUBMITTED/PENDING rather than infer delivery.

The approved Communication and Email Service Owner role is broader than send-only, but it is the existing documented role; live review should confirm whether a supported narrower custom role can replace it without weakening reliability.
recommendation: Extend the existing framework with the official ACS/Monitor transport, atomic ledger states and Bicep controls; keep activation disabled, run independent offline QA, then complete live Azure what-if/deployment and two terminal delivery tests after authorised login before changing autonomous readiness to PASS.
